name: Youchul Jeong
title: PhD Candidate in Marine Science
about: Youchul Jeong is a Ph.D. candidate in the Department of Marine Science at the University of the Aegean (Marine Remote Sensing Group - MRSG) and an External PhD Candidate with the Machine Learning in Earth Observation (MEO) Lab at the University of Bonn. His research develops multi-scale detection frameworks for floating marine debris, integrating multi-sensor satellite data with high-resolution UAV imagery to provide actionable insights into plastic pollution. Working at the intersection of marine remote sensing, machine learning, and image processing, he aims to bridge complex orbital observations with practical environmental management and scalable ocean conservation solutions.

experience.position: Drone Analysis of Beach Safety and Beachgoer Behavior
experience.description: Orchestrated drone flights and implemented the YOLOv8 algorithm to observe beach safety. Conducted surveys of beachgoer population to understand motivations and improve beach conditions.

experience.position: Classification and Monitoring of Floating Marine Macro Litter (MSc Thesis)
experience.description: Utilized drones with multispectral sensors to create a custom FMML dataset. Implemented deep learning models for efficient litter classification and continuous monitoring. Incorporated drone atmospheric correction using DROACOR in collaboration with Dr. Daniel Schläpfer (ReSe Application LLC). Worked with advisors to promote conceptual framework and fieldwork at international conferences.

experience.position: Floating Marine Debris and Physical Ocean Phenomena in S-ORS
experience.description: Applied drone technology and Applied Drone Automatic Flight Advisory in open ocean conditions. Developed a CNN model for detecting marine debris for Socheongcho Ocean Research Station.

experience.position: Drone Survey of Spotted seal Population on Baekryeong Island
experience.description: Conducted drone surveys to assess spotted seal population on Baekryeong Island and gather high-resolution imagery, contributing crucial data to understanding spotted seal dynamics.

experience.position: Floating Marine Litter, Korea Institute of Ocean Science & Technology
experience.description: Worked with Dr. Won Joon Shim (KIOST) to conduct on-site surveys of microplastics and floating marine litter. Compared and analyzed results of drone and multispectral sensor surveys.
Conducted RTK-GPS and drone surveys to analyze coastal sand loss and seabed depth change.

experience.position: UAV Team Leader, Korean Air Force
experience.description: Assembled military training UAVs, managed GPS element procurement, and led team activities.

teaching.description: Developed innovative methodologies including drones, AI, and multi-spectral sensors to contribute to published articles on remote sensing.
[Course No. MS3200990] Led fieldwork for 40 undergraduate students to acquire Sargassum multi-spectral images. Taught data processing using MATLAB as part of the project curriculum.
[Course No. MS3200295] Delivered theoretical lectures on YOLOv5, covering installation process and algorithms.
